_comment: Identities for the golden QA run (evals/run_qa.py). 'steward' is unrestricted (sees every page, including the sales-scoped ones) and answers the answerable questions. 'analyst' is scoped to audiences=['all'] and deliberately does NOT carry 'sales', so the acl-probe questions that target sales-scoped pages are correctly out of scope and must be refused with no existence leak.
